promo.title: For the first e-commerce client
promo.description: If you're the first retailer to close the e-commerce plan with us, we waive the setup. In exchange: a 90-second video testimonial and 3 qualified referrals from your network.

faq.q: How long until the store is ready?
faq.a: 2 weeks with products and materials ready. If you need help with photos or text, we can help but it adds time.

faq.q: Do I need my own domain?
faq.a: We help you get your .com.py or you can use the one you have. Included in setup.

faq.q: Can I add products myself later?
faq.a: Yes, the panel is for you. We train you on usage.

faq.q: How much does it cost to maintain the store?
faq.a: The monthly plan starts at 381,000 Gs and includes hosting, support, maintenance, and backups.
We teach you to configure shipping within the metro area. For the interior we provide WhatsApp coordination templates.

faq.q: Can I see a demo before committing?
faq.a: Yes. We build a demo with test products so you see how it looks and feels.
